citation_style.description: Optional. Adds official.source.citations in this style, or in all six with "all".

claims.description: 1 to 20 claims, each checked on its own.

as_of.description: When the claim was made or published, as a UTC date ("2026-09-15") or date and time with a zone. A claim that was right with the figures published then but was revised or superseded since comes back outdated with accurate_when_made true, and vintage shows then versus now. Level claims only.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code to disambiguate the place.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code when the claim is money: "USD" for $, "EUR" for €. Invokely does not convert currencies; a claim in another currency than the indicator is unverifiable, with indicators in that currency suggested.

indicator.description: Indicator id, for example "population", "unemployment_rate", "cpi_annual_change", "gdp_usd". Call search_indicators first when unsure.

kind.description: level (default): the figure itself. yoy: % change from a year earlier ("prices rose 3% over the year"). pct_change: % change from the previous period. yoy_diff, diff: the same changes in the indicator unit, points for rates ("unemployment fell 0.4 points"). per_capita, per_1000, per_100k: a total divided by population. rank: position among places ("third highest").

period.description: Only when the claim names one: "2026" (year), "2026-Q2" (quarter), "2026-S1" (half), "2026-08" (month). Leave it out, or pass "latest", for claims in the present tense ("is", "has").

place.description: Place name or id as in get_value: "Texas", "Spain", "United States", "Mataró", "es-prov-08", "fips:48453".

qualifier.description: Omit for a plain statement. exact only when the claim says "exactly" (trailing zeros then count as digits); about ("about", "around", "nearly", "roughly"); at_least ("more than", "over", "above", "at least"); at_most ("less than", "under", "below", and "in the top 3" for ranks). Bounds are inclusive.

rank_order.description: rank only: highest (default) or lowest first.

rank_within.description: rank only: the area of the ranking, for example "EU" for "among EU countries", "United States" for states, "Texas" for its counties. Required below country level; omitted for countries means every country.

text.description: Optional original sentence. Echoed back for your records and never interpreted.

tolerance.description: Optional. Replaces the approximately_accurate band (default: 2% of the official value or twice the rounding band, whichever is larger). Never narrower than the rounding the claim implies.

absolute.description: In the same unit as value and unit_hint.

relative.description: Share of the official value, for example 0.05 for 5%.

unit_hint.description: The scale word or unit written: percent (%), percentage_points ("points"), thousands, millions, billions, trillions, or units (a plain number). Omit when nothing is written.

value.description: The number as written, without the scale word or the % sign: 31 for "31 million", 3.2 for "3.2%". Digits with a dot for decimals and no separators: convert "31,290,831" to 31290831, a decimal comma ("3,4%" in Spanish) to 3.4 and a thousands dot ("1.200") to 1200; exponents, words and symbols are refused. A string keeps trailing zeros ("3.40"), which state precision. Negative for a fall in a change claim. For rank, the position (3 for "third highest").

name: check_claim
title: Check a claim
